Description: Grilled chipotle chicken over brown rice with black beans, roasted corn, pico and lime crema.
Seared sirloin with roasted sweet potato, charred broccoli and a chimichurri drizzle.
Grilled chicken with chopped kale and romaine, shaved grana and sourdough croutons in a Caesar dressing.
Slow-cooked pork shoulder in salsa verde over cilantro-lime rice with pickled onion and cotija.

Ground turkey braised with harissa and warm spices over nutty cracked freekeh, folded through with roasted red pepper, charred zucchini, toasted almonds, quick-pickled red onion, chopped mint and parsley, finished with a cooling lemon-garlic yogurt drizzle and a scatter of pomegranate - our biggest bowl and the one the kitchen is proudest of.
Glazed teriyaki salmon over short-grain rice with edamame, cucumber, carrot and sesame.
Crispy baked tofu in a sesame-peanut sauce over noodles with slaw and scallion.
Soft-scrambled eggs, sauteed greens, roasted potato and a turkey-sausage crumble.
Roasted buffalo cauliflower over grains with celery slaw and a blue-cheese drizzle.
